title: Genmab’s cancer bispecific delivers early survival win in ‘exceedingly positive’ Phase 3 readout
snippet: Analysts hailed the Phase 3 head and neck cancer results as a big victory for an asset central to Genmab’s growth plans.

title: Biogen set up for growth even without M&A but CEO won’t rule it out
snippet: Biogen is growing as planned, with marketed products generating more revenue and multiple late-stage readouts expected over the next year. Building out an early-stage pipeline would be a bonus, CEO Chris Viehbacher said on a Q3 earnings call Wednesday.

title: New FDA draft guidance doubles down on expediting approvals of personalized gene therapies
snippet: The FDA has outlined a process for allowing a single application to cover multiple variants of a gene therapy. At the same time, the Centers for Medicare & Medicaid Services has revealed plans to expand the Cell and Gene Therapy Access Model to increase patient access to these products.

title: GSK vaccine sales miss expectations amid falling demand from adults
snippet: With pressure on GSK’s vaccine business, analysts predict the U.K. pharma will face challenges as it prepares for the loss of exclusivity on a key product.

title: Lilly’s retatrutide trounces Novo’s Ozempic in diabetes, weight loss
snippet: Eli Lilly’s next-gen weight loss drug retatrutide soundly beat Novo’s approved medicine Ozempic in weight loss and blood sugar reduction, padding the case for a regulatory application that’s expected in the first quarter of 2027.

title: Astellas bets up to $1.34B for option to advance Audax immuno-oncology asset
snippet: Astellas Pharma could secure the exclusive global rights to Audax Biosciences’ DAX-044, an antibody-cytokine fusion therapy that activates the immune system in the vicinity of the tumor.

title: Biogen notches 3rd straight quarter of growth thanks to newer products, Apellis
snippet: Growth portfolio products like Leqembi and Spinraza helped drive Biogen to $2.8 billion in revenue for the third quarter.

title: 2026 IPO stock tracker: How newly public biotechs are performing
snippet: BioSpace is launching an IPO dashboard to help the industry keep tabs on U.S. biotechs that have taken the public plunge in 2026.
